title: Malaysian Biscuit Delight
description: A simple Malaysian-inspired dessert using biscuits and a velvety topping. This dish is perfect for those looking for a sweet treat.
instructions: Bake the biscuits in the oven for 5-7 minutes or until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, mix the jubilee jam and coconut cream until well combined.
Dip each toasted biscuit into the jam-coconut cream mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated biscuits on a serving plate or individual plates.
Top each biscuit with whipped cream and sprinkle with digestive biscuits crumbs.
